title: The Premier League Is Not a Forecast. It Is a Distribution.
summary: A 2026/27 Premier League forecast built from a constrained top-100 player ranking, five-season club history and three genuinely different season-simulation engines.
key_takeaway: Arsenal and Manchester City are separated by less than one percentage point in the weighted forecast; the model disagreement and uncertainty are the central result, not noise to hide.
